REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE BIYAHENG PINOY nn r U PALAKAD. Legal Opinion No. 44 s. 2011 JUL 26 2011 HON. LIEZEL S. TEVES Chairperson, Sanggunian Bayan of Banaybanay Office of the Sanggunian Bayan Municipality of Banaybanay, Davao Oriental Dear Chairperson Teves: We write regarding your request for opinion on the following: a. Whether it is within the authority of the Sangguniang Bayan (SB) to establish and/or authorize the implementation of an Arabic Education Program; and b. Whether the SB is authorized to create positions under the organizational structure of the Arabic Education Program (AEP). We shall answer you queries in seriatim. Authority of the SB to establish and/or authorize the implementation of an AEP A reading of the attached proposed ordinance reveals that what is sought to be established is a Municipal Arabic Education Development Office (MAEDO) which among other functions, administer and design Arabic Education management programs, curriculum and activities within the Municipality of Banaybanay, Davao Oriental. Notably, the Department of Education (DepEd) under Department Order (DO) No. 51, s. 2005, as amended by DO No. 40, s. 2011, recognized the pressing need for quality curricular offerings for Muslim children. Hence, in its efforts to address these concerns, the DepEd facilitated the formulation of a standard and viable curriculum acceptable and responsive to the needs of Muslim Filipino children in public and private Madaris in Muslim communities in consultation with concerned associations and stakeholders. While LGUs through its sanggunians have the power and duty to approve ordinances which shall ensure the effective and efficient delivery of the basic services and facilities of its constituents, i.e., the construction and maintenance of school facilities as in this case, the authority, accountability and responsibility in implementing national education policies, plans and standards is the prerogative of the DepEd through its Regional Directors since the primary responsibility for the provision of education remains with the National Government. Nevertheless, this does not prevent the Municipality of Banaybanay, Davao Oriental from taking part in improving the quality of education of its Muslim constituents through the establishment of an office which will facilitate the institution of a special Arabic education program, which includes professionalization of Madaris teachers, with the view of improving Arabic Education in said LGU. It must be emphasized however, that this special Arabic education program should be compliant with the standards of the DepEd and should be implemented IN COORDINATION with the DepEd.

Authority of the SB to create positions and fix salaries, wages, a//owances or other emoluments and benefits Pursuant to Section 443 (c) (2) and 447 (1) (viii) of the Local Government Code, the Sangguniang Bayan may create such other offices as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of the municipal government and determine the positions and the salaries, wages, allowances and other emoluments and benefits of officials paid wholly or mainly from municipal funds and provide for expenditures necessary for the proper conduct of programs, projects, services and activities of the municipal government. We hope the foregoing sufficiently addresses your concern. Very truly yours, Director III QUE •V
